# has opening hours

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasOpeningHours`](gmeow-hasOpeningHours.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasOpeningHours>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an offering (or the org/place behind it) to an opening-hours window. Non-functional: several windows coexist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Offering`](../classes/gmeow-Offering.md) -> [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](../classes/gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach a reified [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](../classes/gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md) window to an offering (or the organization/place behind it).

### Avoid when

- Avoid a flat hours literal here (the window's day/open/close belong on the [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](../classes/gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md) node) and avoid one window for incompatible schedules.

### How to use

- Assert one [`gmeow:hasOpeningHours`](gmeow-hasOpeningHours.md) triple per [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](../classes/gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md) window; each window carries its own [`gmeow:openingDay`](gmeow-openingDay.md), [`gmeow:opensAt`](gmeow-opensAt.md), and [`gmeow:closesAt`](gmeow-closesAt.md).

### Examples

- ex:hostingOffer [`gmeow:hasOpeningHours`](gmeow-hasOpeningHours.md) ex:weekdayHours.
